title: Nextera XT DNA Library Prep Protocol: Tagment Genomic DNA and Amplify Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Amplify Libraries. The tagmentation step uses Nextera transposase to fragment DNA into sizes suitable for sequencing, and then tags the DNA with adapter sequences. The library amplification step increases the yield of the tagmented DNA using PCR. PCR adds the Index 1 (i7), Index 2 (i5), and full adapter sequences to the tagmented DNA from the previous step. This protocol assumes you are taking your plate off the OT-2 and thermocycling on a stand-alone PCR machine according to the [Illumina Reference Guide](https://support.illumina.com/content/dam/illumina-support/documents/documentation/chemistry_documentation/samplepreps_nextera/nextera-xt/nextera-xt-library-prep-reference-guide-15031942-05.pdf). After the two steps carried out in this protocol, you can safely stop work and return to it at a later point. If you are stopping, seal the plate and store at 2°C to 8°C for up to 2 days.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter sample count
steps.instruction: In the OT App, input the exact number of samples you will process.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette (see the support article for calibration tips).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the tagmentation and library‑amplification steps.

steps.title: Thermocycle on PCR machine
steps.instruction: After the robot finishes, remove the plate and place it in a stand‑alone PCR thermocycler; run the PCR program exactly as described in the Illumina Reference Guide.

steps.title: Seal and store plate
steps.instruction: If you pause work after these two steps, seal the plate and store it at 2 °C – 8 °C for up to 2 days.
